basis: Mixed-integer optimisation (scipy.optimize.milp) over published policy weights. Section 9.1 is explicit that this optimiser is not machine learning.
message: shedding 1 of 3 transformers for 41.0 kW against a 33.4 kW requirement
critical_load_note: No customer in this generator carries a criticality flag (hospital, water, telecoms), so that term is inert in this run. The constraint is implemented and weighted; it needs a real customer criticality field to bind.
equity_note: The equity term is also inert here, for a different reason: the generator builds every shedding group with an identical 44 h/week burden, just time-offset, so no group is behind any other on cumulative outage hours. On a real ZESA schedule, where groups genuinely differ, this term is what stops the same suburbs absorbing every block. What is actually driving the allocation in this run is load size and thermal stress.
